question: Should sidebar attention dismissals be browser-local preferences scoped to each full gateway route, rather than synchronized acknowledgements in gateway state?
rationale: The choice determines whether operational warnings are acknowledged per browser or consistently across devices, and that product contract cannot be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Per-route browser dismissal
options.body: Keep the lightweight localStorage design but use query-preserving gateway identity and fix the remaining lifecycle defects.

options.title: Gateway-synchronized acknowledgement
options.body: Add an explicit gateway-owned acknowledgement contract so dismissals follow the operator across browsers and devices.

options.title: Keep alerts persistent
options.body: Do not add dismissals if these warnings must remain visible until the underlying condition clears.

recommendation.title: Per-route browser dismissal
recommendation.body: Keep the lightweight localStorage design but use query-preserving gateway identity and fix the remaining lifecycle defects.

likelyOwner.reason: They proposed the client-local product semantics and also have current-main repository history beyond this branch.
